annotations.title: Sign in to Nepternship by email code

description: Email a 6-digit sign-in code to an existing Nepternship member. Use this when a member who is not connected in this conversation wants to use their account (see their introductions, send a request). Returns a claim_code; after verify_code succeeds, pass that claim_code on every later call.
